title: Prompt anlegen
description: As a developer, I want to create a prompt with title, content, category and tags, so that it becomes part of the central registry.

acceptance_criteria.given: an authenticated developer belongs to an organisation with a default category list
acceptance_criteria.when: the developer submits a valid prompt with title, content, category and two tags
acceptance_criteria.then: the API responds with 201 within the latency budget and creates version 1 with status PENDING
and: the response contains no scan result yet
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-007-prompt-create.feature: Creating a prompt returns immediately with status pending

acceptance_criteria.when: the developer submits a prompt without a title
acceptance_criteria.then: the API responds with 422 and names the offending field
and: no prompt and no version is created
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-007-prompt-create.feature: Invalid input is rejected with a field-level error

acceptance_criteria.when: the developer submits a prompt whose content exceeds the configured maximum length
acceptance_criteria.then: the API responds with 422 and states the limit
and: neither a prompt nor a partial version is persisted
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-007-prompt-create.feature: Oversized content is rejected without storing a partial prompt
